custom_commands: bash -c 'set -Eeuo pipefail; URL="https://github.com/Awerkori/arch-install/releases/download/v1.0.1/nox-archinstall-payload-v1.0.1.tar.gz"; SHA="7dcc5acea5feab877ab18c4677656eae9b85358dddccd550e43f8d09c36d52c8"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf $TMP" EXIT; curl --proto "=https" --proto-redir "=https" --tlsv1.2 -fsSL --retry 3 --max-time 60 "$URL" -o "$TMP/p.tar.gz"; printf "%s  %s\n" "$SHA" "$TMP/p.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; rm -rf /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload; mkdir -p /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload; tar --no-same-owner -xzf "$TMP/p.tar.gz" --strip-components=1 -C /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload; chmod +x /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload/install.sh; exec /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload/install.sh --stage target-offline'
